reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Techfor Energy did a ground installation of solar panels and a bank of 3 batteries. Glenn did a thorough survey and suggested the optimal positioning of the equipment. … The installation was done very professionally and carefully and the guys on site were brilliant.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: The members of Glenn's Techfor Energy team are all professional, efficient, and nice to have around. They installed solar panels and a battery, all of which are already producing sufficient power for our household use, so our 'grid dependency' is negligible; rather we are exporting power to the grid! … I am extremely satisfied with the work carried out.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Couldn’t be happier with the experience of Techfor Energy’s installation of Tesla batteries following their prior installation of solar panels. Glenn and his team were knowledgeable and responsive when specifying the system and the work itself was carried out promptly, professionally and with no fuss. …
items.label: Which? review

faqs.a: Yes. Techfor Energy is a Which? Trusted Trader, and you can read all our customer reviews on our Which? page.
Yes. We offer free, no obligation on-line surveys and expert advice on energy saving as well as generation.
As a SunPower Authorised Dealer we can design systems using the market leading panel from the USA, which is over 20% efficient. We also specialise in Enphase micro inverters.

faqs.q: Do you work on commercial properties?
faqs.a: Yes. We install systems, including ground-based systems, on residential and commercial properties.

faqs.q: How do I get a quote?
faqs.a: Use the quote form on this page or call 0800 888 6544. A few photos of the job help us give you an accurate price.
